title: [review] lora_ipv6_mesh-mkk4: rust/target/ build artifacts committed
description:
Commit d83cbc5 includes build artifacts under rust/target/:
- rust/target/debug/deps/lichen_gateway-f1ce66f1c4497e73.d (dep file)
- rust/target/debug/incremental/lichen_gateway-22bf9b6an4f75/s-hkp20uavb7-14gy7hh-working/dep-graph.part.bin (incremental compile artifact)
- rust/target/debug/incremental/lichen_gateway-22bf9b6an4f75/s-hkp20uavb7-14gy7hh.lock (incremental compile lock)

These are generated build artifacts that should never be committed to the repo. They can contain stale/personally identifiable paths and will cause merge conflicts as different machines produce different versions. The `rust/target/` directory likely needs to be in .gitignore or this is a CI/agent misconfiguration where the agent committed untracked files unintentionally.
